title: Jaded Juice Cooled Middle-Eastern Rhubarb Fattoush
description: A refreshing twist on the classic Middle-Eastern salad, featuring tart rhubarb and a cooling ice bath. This diabetic-friendly dish is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rhubarb, parsley, mint, pita bread, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, pour the crushed ice over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
To make this recipe even quicker, you can toast the pita bread in a toaster oven or under the broiler for a few minutes.
For an added burst of flavor, try adding some chopped fresh herbs like cilantro or dill to the salad.
This salad is best made just before serving, as the rhubarb can become soggy if it sits for too long in the dressing.
If you prefer a creamier salad, you can add some crumbled goat cheese or feta cheese to the mix.
To make this salad even more diabetic-friendly, try using a sugar-free dressing or omitting the feta cheese.
This salad is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner, and can be made in under 30 minutes.
